description:
## Goal

Replace the generic one-consumer contribution abstraction with one explicit, change-aware ActivationInputMap that owns exact publisher rows and their joined antichain.

## Model

Exact paired-row identity and dominance come from fz-kdt.48. Publisher conclusion replaces or withdraws only that publisher's contribution under the generic grounded/source-ownership rules. Unchanged publisher rows preserve allocation, position and aggregate generation. Changed contributors update only affected antichain membership; no display rendering or full unrelated-contributor rebuild is authority.

A simple full rebuild may exist only in tests as a differential oracle. Production retains one store, not parallel incremental and compatibility aggregates.

## Required deletion

Delete ContributionMap/JoinContribution surfaces used only by ActivationInputs, generic wrappers, full remove/clone/sort/rejoin on equal updates, redundant telemetry, adapters and stale docs.

## Acceptance

Insertion-order and replacement histories yield identical exact rows, collapse events, activation semantics, work and artifacts. Same contribution is quiet; one changed publisher performs proportional work; exact withdrawal preserves other publishers. Full causal and semantic gates pass.

This ticket absorbs fz-tfn.19.
title: Make ActivationInputs one change-aware contribution authority
